task: Browse recipes for gluten-free chocolate chip cookies that can be made without nuts.
agent_final_answer:
On Cookpad I searched "gluten free chocolate chip cookies" and applied the right-side "Exclude" filter for "nuts". The results header now reads "Gluten free chocolate chip cookies (50) - Without: nuts", giving 50 gluten-free chocolate chip cookie recipes that can be made without nuts.

Notable nut-free, gluten-free chocolate chip cookie recipes found:
- Cookie Dough Bars GF (Dan Flynn) - gluten free flour, brown sugar, butter, vanilla, salt, milk, dark chocolate chip; 20 min, 8 servings
- Blueberry White Chocolate Cookies GF (Dan Flynn) - gluten free flour, blueberries, sugar, butter, baking powder, salt, white chocolate chips; 10 min, 36 servings
- Vegan Gluten free Chocolate Chip Cookie (Shikha Yashu Jethi) - vegetable margarine, banana compote, brown sugar, gluten-free yeast, rice flour, chocolate chips; 15 min
- Gluten-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies (RJ Penn) - shortening, butter, eggs, sugar, dark brown sugar, GF all-purpose flour, salt, baking powder, semi-sweet chocolate chips
- Gluten Free Chocolate Chip Cookies (Jim Kennedy) - butter, brown/granulated sugar, vanilla, salt, eggs, GF flour blend, rice flour, oat bran, baking powder/soda, chocolate chips; 2 dozen
- Chocolate Chip Cookies (Stephanie Goldman) - GF flour, xanthan gum, baking soda, salt, butter, sugar substitute, coconut/brown sugar, vanilla, eggs, semi-sweet chocolate chips; 10 min, 50 servings
- Gluten free chocolate chip cookies (shari.l.george) - butter, brown sugar, vanilla, eggs, King Arthur GF baking mix, milk, chocolate chips
- Vickys Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies, Gluten/Dairy/Egg & Soy-Free (Vicky@Jacks Free-From Cookbook) - explicitly free of common allergens; GF flour mix, baking soda, xanthan gum, salt, agave, applesauce, oil, vanilla, chocolate chips; 55 min, 36 servings
- Banana Oatmeal Breakfast Cookies 3-Ingredient - bananas, oats, mini chocolate chips

Note: the "nuts" keyword filter is text-based, so a few returned results still list nut ingredients (e.g. peanut butter, almond/cashew flour, ground almonds). The recipes listed above contain no nuts and are good nut-free choices. Several of Vicky's recipes also carry the "NF" (nut-free) tag.
